# Standard Directory Structure

Each project in RStudio should follow a consistent directory structure.

project/
│
├── R/
│ scripts for reusable functions
│
├── analysis/
│ numbered analysis scripts
│
├── data_raw/
│ original raw data (never edited)
│
├── data_processed/
│ cleaned or derived datasets
│
├── output/
│ figures and tables
│
├── docs/
│ rendered reports
│
├── renv/
│ package environment
│
├── project.Rproj
│
└── README.md

---

# Directory Descriptions

## R/

Reusable functions used across analyses.

Example:


R/
  clean_sensor_data.R
  plot_air_quality.R
  download_epa_data.R

---

## analysis/

Sequential analysis scripts.

Example:

analysis/
  01_download_epa_data.R
  02_clean_data.R
  03_merge_datasets.R
  04_generate_figures.R

---

## data_raw/

Raw data should **never be modified**.

Examples:

- EPA downloads
- sensor network data
- instrument exports

---

## data_processed/

Cleaned datasets used for analysis.

---

## output/

Generated figures and tables (in separate subfolders).
